topics.title: Avenciguat (sGC activator) in GN Ph III (1366-0015) — RoFD on Hold, EoP2 Queries

background.text: HPSC did not endorse RoFD in Apr and requested team to return in Jun with de-risking activities. Different scenarios of adding futility analysis and implications on project timeline and budget are under discussion. Ph III trial preparation currently on hold; no impact on EoPh II HAI; IAP release after RoFD endorsement; China ICP expected if best case launch still within 2029.
background.quote:
HPSC didn’t endorse RoFD in Apr and requested the team to come back in Jun with de-risking activities.
Different scenarios of adding futility analysis and implications on project timeline and budget are under discussion.
As the consequence:
1) Ph III trial preparation is currently on hold
2) no impact on EoPh II HAI
3) IAP release after RoFD endorsement; China ICP expected if best case launch still within 2029

background.text: EoP2 clinical queries received on 29 Apr; team targets to respond by mid next week though no timeline was specified by the reviewer. Global team prefers CDE feedback before HPSC in Jun (meeting date TBD). Queries from non-clinical, CMC, Stats are pending. Unlikely to have virtual meeting if queries addressed through written response.
background.quote:
EoP2 clinical queries were received on 29 Apr.
Team targets to respond by mid next week though no timeline was specified by the reviewer. Global team prefers CDE feedback before HPSC in Jun (meeting date TBD).

Unlikely to have a virtual meeting if queries could be clearly addressed through written response.

background.text: Ph III timeline likely to shift due to delayed RoFD. China approval base case: Sep 2029 (conditional), Jun 2031 (full).
background.quote:
Avenciguat in GN Ph III (1366-0015) timeline
likely to shift due to delayed RoFD

background.text: EoP2 queries require further evidence on robustness of Ph II efficacy/safety in IgAN/FSGS/MN population and justification of Ph III design for proposed label, to fill potential gaps (e.g. dose, population, endpoints).
background.quote:
To provide further evidence to show the robustness of Ph II efficacy and safety results in IgAN/FSGS/MN population
To provide further evidence to justify why the Ph II results could support such Ph III design for the proposed label, to fill the potential gaps (e.g. dose, population, endpoints etc.)

decision.text: HPSC did not endorse RoFD in Apr; requested team to return in Jun with de-risking activities.
decision.quote: HPSC didn’t endorse RoFD in Apr and requested the team to come back in Jun with de-risking activities.
